integrity: Proof uses exact rational Taylor intervals and analytic asymptotics; verifier supplied.
scientific_limitations: Reentrance is proved via signs at the limits and at one finite shape, not by a complete zero count.
The sites are prescribed and not claimed to be variance-optimal.
The claim is for zero-nugget Gaussian kernel quadrature on a uniform interval.
Publication priority is provisional pending independent mathematical and literature review.
title: Reentrant positivity and the sharp half-weight boundary for four symmetric Gaussian quadrature nodes
